@Bettina Kroll: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2 said ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own Dec 8 cutover recap also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

You kept running the account day to day until the terminal cutover finished. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22, 2025, so use that date only if the tracker wants the operational takeover rather than the official change.
